echo --- flags; git diff --stat "origin/production..$SHA" -- '*db/migrate*' '*alembic*' '.do/' '.github/workflows/'
echo --- all; git diff --stat "origin/production..$SHA"
git branch -a

cd $SANDBOX/harbor-web
SHA=811457c83805d8c9dbf4cc3429afaa5e9bb1c038
